up: Retrieve the compound ChEMBL ID, exact activity values (standard_value, standard_units, standard_relation), and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4296802. Only include rows where the activity standard_relation is '='. Join activities to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on the molecule identifier. Do not apply any additional filters on confidence_score, target_type, doc_type, or standard_units.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4296802' AND a.standard_relation = '='
